concept.hr: CRC otkriva rafalne pogreške koje paritet promaši
concept.en: A CRC catches the burst errors that parity misses

summary.hr: Pošiljatelj dijeli poruku modulo 2 i šalje ostatak kao FCS. Promijeni bitove na vodu: paritet promaši paran broj, CRC otkriva rafal.
summary.en: The sender divides the message modulo 2 and sends the remainder as the FCS. Flip bits on the line: parity misses an even count, a CRC still detects the burst.
